subject_scope: same frozen 12 corrected C1-primary Knight d8 roots; local research only

target_lattice.reason: d11 proof leaves align exactly to one 4x4x4 d13 extraction block; coarser d9/d10 certified leaves cover integer unions of these blocks

planner_classes.CERTIFIED_EMPTY: covered by a terminal corrected-C0 strict-sign proof; block may be pruned without sampling-based absence inference
planner_classes.PROVEN_SURFACE: terminal GRAPH or unresolved terminal with C0 PROVEN_ZERO_EXISTS; block must remain active
planner_classes.UNCERTAIN: terminal unresolved with C0 UNKNOWN; block remains active and may not be treated as empty from same-sign target corners

frozen_audits: every d13 block maps to exactly one final proof-partition leaf
CERTIFIED_EMPTY block must have no direct d13 corner sign bracket
PROVEN_SURFACE block with no d13 corner bracket is a hidden-surface sampling alarm, not permission to prune
UNCERTAIN block with no d13 corner bracket remains unresolved/active
all corner-bracketed nonempty blocks extracted with X2 blockwise Lewiner MC must reproduce dense d13 Lewiner MC on the same 12 root lattices
primary_metrics: sample/query reduction relative to dense 12-root d13 evaluation
claim_boundary: X3 does not run a full Knight witness and does not claim source-raster fidelity. It only tests whether the proof partition can safely drive the existing MC contourer on a fixed d13 local lattice.
